name: Gia đình và nhà cửa
description: Người thân, các phòng và đồ dùng trong nhà, việc nhà: những từ thường gặp chưa có trong bộ 3000 từ. Nội dung do AI soạn. Giấy phép CC BY-SA 4.0.

words.explanationEn: the mother or father of your mother or father
words.example: My grandparents live in a small village.
words.exampleVi: Ông bà tôi sống ở một ngôi làng nhỏ.

words.explanationEn: the son of your son or daughter
words.example: Her grandson visits her every Sunday.
words.exampleVi: Cháu trai của bà đến thăm bà mỗi Chủ nhật.

words.explanationEn: the female child of one of your children
words.example: His granddaughter is learning to read.
words.exampleVi: Cháu gái của ông đang tập đọc.

words.explanationEn: a son or daughter of one of your children
words.example: Their first grandchild was born in May.
words.exampleVi: Đứa cháu đầu tiên của họ chào đời vào tháng Năm.

words.explanationEn: the daughter of your brother or sister
words.meaningVi: cháu gái (con của anh chị em)
words.example: I bought a toy for my niece.
words.exampleVi: Tôi mua một món đồ chơi cho cháu gái.

words.explanationEn: the son of your brother or sister
words.meaningVi: cháu trai (con của anh chị em)
words.example: My nephew is three years old.
words.exampleVi: Cháu trai tôi ba tuổi.

words.explanationEn: a brother or sister
words.example: Do you have any siblings?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có anh chị em nào không?

words.explanationEn: your husband or wife
words.example: You can bring your spouse to the party.
words.exampleVi: Bạn có thể đưa vợ hoặc chồng đến bữa tiệc.

words.explanationEn: the wife of your father who did not give birth to you
words.example: She gets on well with her stepmother.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy hoà thuận với mẹ kế.

words.explanationEn: the husband of your mother who is not your real parent
words.example: His stepfather taught him to swim.
words.exampleVi: Cha dượng dạy anh ấy bơi.

words.explanationEn: the female parent of your husband or wife
words.example: My mother-in-law cooks very well.
words.exampleVi: Mẹ chồng tôi nấu ăn rất ngon.

words.explanationEn: a baby that is only a few days or weeks old
words.example: The newborn slept all afternoon.
words.exampleVi: Em bé sơ sinh ngủ suốt buổi chiều.

words.explanationEn: a young child who is just learning to walk
words.example: The toddler fell down and laughed.
words.exampleVi: Đứa bé mới biết đi ngã xuống rồi cười.

words.explanationEn: a person paid to look after children while their parents are out
words.example: We need a babysitter for Saturday night.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi cần người trông trẻ vào tối thứ Bảy.

words.explanationEn: a woman on her wedding day
words.example: The bride wore a white dress.
words.exampleVi: Cô dâu mặc váy trắng.

words.explanationEn: a man on his wedding day
words.example: The groom gave a short speech.
words.exampleVi: Chú rể phát biểu ngắn.

words.explanationEn: the man you have promised to marry
words.example: Her fiancé works in Hanoi.
words.exampleVi: Vị hôn phu của cô ấy làm việc ở Hà Nội.

words.explanationEn: a woman whose husband has died
words.example: The old widow lives alone.
words.exampleVi: Bà góa già sống một mình.

words.explanationEn: a family member who lived a long time before you
words.example: We visit the graves of our ancestors at Tet.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi đi thăm mộ tổ tiên vào dịp Tết.

words.explanationEn: a person who shares a flat or bedroom with you
words.example: My roommate is always cooking noodles.
words.exampleVi: Bạn cùng phòng của tôi lúc nào cũng nấu mì.

words.explanationEn: a person who owns a house or flat and rents it to others
words.example: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.exampleVi: Chủ nhà đã sửa cái cửa sổ bị vỡ.

words.explanationEn: a person who pays money to live in a place that belongs to someone else
words.example: The new tenants moved in last week.
words.exampleVi: Những người thuê nhà mới dọn đến tuần trước.

words.explanationEn: the main space in a house where a family sits, talks and watches TV
words.example: We watch TV in the living room.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi xem TV trong phòng khách.

words.explanationEn: the part of a house with a big table where the family eats meals together
words.example: Dinner is ready in the dining room.
words.exampleVi: Bữa tối đã sẵn sàng trong phòng ăn.

words.explanationEn: a long narrow space inside a building with doors to rooms
words.example: Leave your shoes in the hallway.
words.exampleVi: Để giày của bạn ở hành lang.

words.explanationEn: a set of steps inside a building that goes from one floor to another
words.example: The staircase is very steep.
words.exampleVi: Cầu thang rất dốc.

words.explanationEn: a room or floor of a house below the ground
words.example: We keep old boxes in the basement.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi để thùng cũ dưới tầng hầm.

words.explanationEn: a room or space just under the roof of a house
words.example: I found my old toys in the attic.
words.exampleVi: Tôi tìm thấy đồ chơi cũ trên gác mái.

words.explanationEn: a small platform outside an upstairs window where you can stand or sit
words.example: She grows flowers on her balcony.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy trồng hoa ở ban công.

words.explanationEn: a covered area at the entrance of a house
words.example: Grandpa likes to sit on the porch.
words.exampleVi: Ông thích ngồi ở hiên nhà.

words.explanationEn: the garden or open area behind a house
words.example: The kids are playing in the backyard.
words.exampleVi: Bọn trẻ đang chơi ở sân sau.

words.explanationEn: an area of short grass in a garden
words.example: Dad mows the lawn every weekend.
words.exampleVi: Bố cắt cỏ mỗi cuối tuần.

words.explanationEn: a short private road from the street to a house or garage
words.example: Please park in the driveway.
words.exampleVi: Vui lòng đỗ xe ở lối vào nhà.

words.explanationEn: a container outside a house where letters are delivered
words.example: There is a letter in the mailbox.
words.exampleVi: Có một lá thư trong hộp thư.

words.explanationEn: a button by the entrance that rings inside the house
words.example: The doorbell rang at midnight.
words.exampleVi: Chuông cửa reo lúc nửa đêm.

words.explanationEn: the flat area just outside the front entrance of a house
words.example: The package was left on the doorstep.
words.exampleVi: Gói hàng được để ở bậc cửa.

words.explanationEn: a small rug at the entrance where you wipe your shoes
words.example: Wipe your feet on the doormat.
words.exampleVi: Chùi chân lên thảm chùi chân nhé.

words.explanationEn: a tall pipe that takes smoke from a fire up through the roof
words.example: Smoke was coming out of the chimney.
words.exampleVi: Khói đang bốc ra từ ống khói.

words.explanationEn: a small room or cupboard built into a wall for storing clothes
words.meaningVi: tủ âm tường, phòng chứa đồ
words.example: Hang your coat in the closet.
words.exampleVi: Treo áo khoác vào tủ âm tường.

words.explanationEn: a tall cupboard where you hang clothes
words.example: Her wardrobe is full of dresses.
words.exampleVi: Tủ quần áo của cô ấy đầy váy.

words.explanationEn: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for storing things
words.example: The cups are in the cupboard.
words.exampleVi: Cốc ở trong tủ.

words.explanationEn: a piece of furniture with shelves for novels, dictionaries and magazines
words.example: The bookcase is full of old novels.
words.exampleVi: Tủ sách đầy tiểu thuyết cũ.

words.explanationEn: a long soft seat for two or more people
words.example: He fell asleep on the couch.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy ngủ quên trên ghế dài.

words.explanationEn: a comfortable seat with sides that support your arms
words.example: Grandma is reading in her armchair.
words.exampleVi: Bà đang đọc sách trên ghế bành.

words.explanationEn: a soft bag filled with material that you sit on or lean against
words.example: Put a cushion behind your back.
words.exampleVi: Đặt một cái gối tựa sau lưng bạn.

words.explanationEn: a thick piece of cloth that covers part of a floor
words.example: The cat is sleeping on the rug.
words.exampleVi: Con mèo đang ngủ trên tấm thảm.

words.explanationEn: the thick soft part of a bed that you lie on
words.example: This mattress is too hard for me.
words.exampleVi: Tấm nệm này quá cứng với tôi.

words.explanationEn: a thick soft cover filled with feathers that you sleep under
words.example: I need a warmer duvet for winter.
words.exampleVi: Tôi cần một cái chăn bông ấm hơn cho mùa đông.

words.explanationEn: a small bed with high sides for a baby
words.example: The baby is sleeping in her crib.
words.exampleVi: Em bé đang ngủ trong cũi.

words.explanationEn: a small chair on wheels for pushing a baby around
words.example: She pushed the stroller through the park.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy đẩy xe em bé qua công viên.

words.explanationEn: a room in a house where a baby sleeps and plays
words.example: They painted the nursery yellow.
words.exampleVi: Họ sơn phòng em bé màu vàng.

words.explanationEn: a glass object that gives out brightness when electricity goes through it
words.example: Can you change the lightbulb in the kitchen?
words.exampleVi: Bạn thay giúp bóng đèn trong bếp được không?

words.explanationEn: a place in the wall where you connect electrical equipment
words.example: There is no socket near the bed.
words.exampleVi: Không có ổ cắm nào gần giường.

words.explanationEn: the part at the end of an electric wire that you push into the wall to get power
words.example: Pull out the plug before you clean the fan.
words.exampleVi: Rút phích cắm trước khi lau quạt.

words.explanationEn: a device that controls the flow of water from a pipe
words.example: The kitchen faucet is dripping.
words.exampleVi: Vòi nước trong bếp đang nhỏ giọt.

words.explanationEn: a long container you fill with water and sit in to wash your body
words.example: The children played in the bathtub.
words.exampleVi: Bọn trẻ chơi trong bồn tắm.

words.explanationEn: a thick cream you put on a brush to clean your teeth
words.example: We are out of toothpaste.
words.exampleVi: Nhà mình hết kem đánh răng rồi.

words.explanationEn: a liquid soap for washing your hair
words.example: This shampoo smells like apples.
words.exampleVi: Dầu gội này có mùi táo.

words.explanationEn: a soft object full of holes that takes in water, used for cleaning
words.example: Use a sponge to wash the car.
words.exampleVi: Dùng miếng bọt biển để rửa xe.

words.explanationEn: an open container with a handle for carrying water
words.example: Fill the bucket with warm water.
words.exampleVi: Đổ đầy nước ấm vào xô.

words.explanationEn: a stick with soft strings at one end for washing floors
words.example: Where is the mop?
words.exampleVi: Cây lau nhà ở đâu rồi?

words.explanationEn: a brush with a long handle for cleaning floors
words.example: She swept the yard with a broom.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy quét sân bằng chổi.

words.explanationEn: a flat container with a handle that you sweep dirt into
words.example: Hold the dustpan while I sweep.
words.exampleVi: Cầm cái hốt rác trong lúc tôi quét nhé.

words.explanationEn: an electric machine that sucks up dirt from floors and carpets
words.example: Our vacuum cleaner is very loud.
words.exampleVi: Máy hút bụi nhà tôi rất ồn.

words.explanationEn: clothes and sheets that need washing or have just been washed
words.meaningVi: quần áo cần giặt hoặc vừa giặt
words.example: I do the laundry on Sundays.
words.exampleVi: Tôi giặt đồ vào Chủ nhật.

words.explanationEn: a liquid or powder used for washing clothes or plates
words.example: Don't use too much detergent.
words.exampleVi: Đừng dùng quá nhiều bột giặt.

words.explanationEn: an electric appliance that cleans clothes with water and soap
words.example: The washing machine is broken again.
words.exampleVi: Máy giặt lại hỏng rồi.

words.explanationEn: a machine that washes plates, cups and pans
words.example: Put the plates in the dishwasher.
words.exampleVi: Cho đĩa vào máy rửa bát.

words.explanationEn: an electric device that cools the inside of a building on hot days
words.example: Turn on the air conditioner, it's hot.
words.exampleVi: Bật máy điều hoà lên, nóng quá.

words.explanationEn: a small device by your bed that rings at a set time to wake you up
words.example: My alarm clock goes off at six.
words.exampleVi: Đồng hồ báo thức của tôi reo lúc sáu giờ.

words.explanationEn: a small device you use to change TV channels from a distance
words.example: I can't find the remote control.
words.exampleVi: Tôi không tìm thấy cái điều khiển.

words.explanationEn: a container for holding cut flowers
words.example: She put the roses in a glass vase.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy cắm hoa hồng vào một bình thuỷ tinh.

words.explanationEn: a large piece of material spread over the place where you eat meals
words.example: He spilled tea on the tablecloth.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy làm đổ trà lên khăn trải bàn.

words.explanationEn: a small job you have to do regularly at home, like washing up
words.example: Each child has a few chores to do.
words.exampleVi: Mỗi đứa trẻ có vài việc nhà phải làm.

words.explanationEn: cleaning, cooking and washing that you do at home
words.example: We share the housework equally.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi chia đều việc nhà.

words.explanationEn: neat and with everything in its place
words.example: Keep your room tidy.
words.exampleVi: Hãy giữ phòng của con gọn gàng.

words.explanationEn: to clean something by rubbing it hard with a brush
words.example: She scrubbed the floor until it shone.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy cọ sàn đến khi sáng bóng.

words.explanationEn: a tool with a heavy metal head for hitting nails
words.example: Pass me the hammer, please.
words.exampleVi: Đưa tôi cái búa với.

words.explanationEn: a thin piece of metal with a sharp point that you hit into wood
words.example: He hung the picture on a nail.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy treo bức tranh lên một cái đinh.

words.explanationEn: a set of steps between two long pieces of wood or metal, used for climbing
words.example: Hold the ladder while I climb up.
words.exampleVi: Giữ thang trong lúc tôi trèo lên nhé.

words.explanationEn: a tool with a thin metal end for turning small pointed metal fasteners
words.example: I need a small screwdriver to open the toy.
words.exampleVi: Tôi cần một cái tua vít nhỏ để mở món đồ chơi.

words.explanationEn: a line of bushes growing close together around a garden
words.example: The hedge needs cutting.
words.exampleVi: Hàng rào cây cần được cắt tỉa.
